description: This file defines a PHP class LoggerStringMatchFilter which is a filter used in the log4php logging framework. It performs string matching on log event messages to determine whether to accept, deny, or be neutral.

classes.name: LoggerStringMatchFilter
classes.description: A simple filter based on string matching within the log4php framework, allowing messages to be accepted or denied based on the presence of a specific string.

methods.name: getAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Returns whether the filter accepts on match, a boolean value.

methods.name: setAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Sets the filter to accept on match, converting string inputs to boolean if necessary.

methods.name: getStringToMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the string that the filter is configured to match against log messages.

methods.name: setStringToMatch
methods.description: Sets the string to match in log messages.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Determines whether a log event should be accepted, denied, or neutral based on string matching logic.
